Escape attempt.requires: a route out and a means to reach it
Escape attempt.provides: movement toward the perimeter, urgency, individual or small-group scale

Contraband introduction.provides: no movement of people out, sustained repeat activity, economic motive

Concerted indiscipline.provides: loss of control of an area, no boundary crossing, negotiable

Hostage taking of staff.requires: isolation of a staff member and a demand
Hostage taking of staff.provides: life at immediate risk, containment within the establishment, negotiable

Individual prisoner acting alone.provides: limited means, opportunistic, no external logistics

Organised prisoner group.provides: coordinated action, internal enforcement, no direct access beyond the wall

Corrupt staff member.provides: movement of items through controlled points, keys and information, no prisoner status

External accomplice outside.provides: delivery to the outside face of the boundary, no internal access

Perimeter breach.provides: a route out, triggers boundary detection, no use for delivering items covertly

Vehicle gate.provides: concealment volume, controlled point with searching, both directions

Visits hall.provides: person-to-person transfer, supervised, no route out

Drone delivery over the wall.requires: an operator outside and a drop point inside
Drone delivery over the wall.provides: delivery of small items only, no route out, defeats ground perimeter controls

Fixed camera surveillance.provides: observation of movement in covered areas, no detection of concealed items

Cell and area search.provides: discovery of concealed items, nothing about intent

Intelligence from prisoners.provides: advance warning of intent, unreliable and unpredictable

Perimeter sensor alarm.requires: an intrusion or breach at the boundary
Perimeter sensor alarm.provides: immediate boundary alert, blind to anything internal

Lockdown of the establishment.provides: immediate loss of movement, no resolution of an ongoing situation

Segregation of individuals.provides: removal of instigators, useless where the actors are unknown

Negotiation.requires: someone with a demand willing to talk

External police intervention.provides: armed capability, loss of internal control of the incident

_v1_notes.INCIDENT TYPE|ORIGIN: concerted indiscipline and hostage taking are both N for a corrupt staff member and an external accomplice - neither originates a disturbance among prisoners.
_v1_notes.INCIDENT TYPE|PHYSICAL ROUTE: concerted indiscipline and hostage taking involve no boundary crossing at all, so every physical route is N. An escape attempt is N via the visits hall and via drone - neither provides a route out.
_v1_notes.INCIDENT TYPE|DETECTION MEANS: contraband is N for perimeter sensors. Concerted indiscipline and hostage taking are both N for cell search and N for perimeter alarm - neither is an item or a boundary event.
_v1_notes.INCIDENT TYPE|RESPONSE: an escape attempt is N for negotiation. Contraband is N for negotiation and N for external police intervention.
_v1_notes.ORIGIN|PHYSICAL ROUTE: an individual acting alone is N at the vehicle gate and N by drone - both need an accomplice outside. An external accomplice is N for perimeter breach, vehicle gate and visits hall as the origin, having no internal access; drone is precisely their method. A corrupt staff member is N for drone delivery.
_v1_notes.ORIGIN|DETECTION MEANS: a corrupt staff member is N for perimeter sensors. An external accomplice is N for cell and area search.
_v1_notes.ORIGIN|RESPONSE: a corrupt staff member is N for segregation and N for negotiation - neither applies to staff. An external accomplice is N for lockdown, segregation and negotiation alike; only police intervention reaches them.
_v1_notes.PHYSICAL ROUTE|DETECTION MEANS: perimeter breach is N for cell search and N for prisoner intelligence as the detecting means at the moment of breach. Vehicle gate and visits hall are both N for perimeter sensors. Drone is N for cell search.
_v1_notes.PHYSICAL ROUTE|RESPONSE: every physical route is N for negotiation - there is nobody with a demand in a boundary-crossing event.
